criteria.criterion: Clearly rejects evacuation for planned maintenance
criteria.evidence: "Non, je ne recommande pas cette approche pour une campagne de patchs... c'est un outil de reprise après panne, pas de maintenance planifiée."

criteria.criterion: Explains the double-write / split-brain risk on shared storage
criteria.evidence: "la même instance peut tourner à deux endroits sur les mêmes volumes RBD. Deux écritures concurrentes peuvent corrompre les disques. Nova ne fence pas l'hôte à votre place."

criteria.criterion: Notes that stopping nova-compute leaves instances running
criteria.evidence: "Les VMs continuent de tourner sur l'hôte. Arrêter nova-compute n'arrête pas les processus QEMU."

criteria.criterion: Offers alternatives with conditions (live migration tuning within capacity, cold migration, coordinated restart)
criteria.evidence: Alternatives 1–3: parallel live migrations in batches "dans la limite de vos baselines, par hôte et par domaine de panne" with stop conditions; "openstack server stop, puis cold migrate ou reboot de l'hôte" for restart-tolerant workloads; tuning of max_concurrent_live_migrations, bandwidth, auto-converge/post-copy.

critical_errors.error: endorses evacuating a host that is still running its instances
critical_errors.evidence: The response rejects the proposal. Option 4 allows evacuate only "après extinction physique confirmée de l'hôte (IPMI ou équivalent), vérifiée par virsh list". That is fencing, so the host is no longer running its instances.

critical_errors.error: claims Ceph makes evacuation safe in this case
critical_errors.evidence: It says evacuate "fonctionne mécaniquement" on Ceph, then explains the concurrent-write corruption risk on the shared RBD volumes. It never presents Ceph as making the evacuation safe.

summary: The response gives a clear, reasoned no. It names evacuate as a recovery tool for failed hosts. It explains that QEMU keeps running after nova-compute stops, which leads to double writes on the shared RBD volumes. It offers conditioned alternatives: batched live migration within capacity, stop/cold migrate/restart for tolerant workloads, and a landing zone. It allows evacuate only with confirmed fencing. No critical errors were committed. There are no book citations, and no environment facts were invented.
